parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* true (default): Uses coupons.
* false: Does not use coupons.

parameters.name: HotStandbyCluster
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:

- **on**: Enables the hot standby cluster.
- **equal**: Enables the peer cluster.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query region information.

parameters.name: StandbyAZ
parameters.description:
The zone of the hot standby storage cluster. Valid values:

- **auto** (default): Automatically selected.
> When the HotStandbyCluster parameter is set to on, you can use the default value. When the HotStandbyCluster parameter is set to equal, you must specify a specific zone. You can call the [DescribeZones](~~98041~~) operation to query zone details.
